summary.text: Wendy Hausman is a Republican member of the Missouri House of Representatives, District 65, who assumed office on January 4, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Hausman has worked in marketing and business development.

paragraphs.text: Wendy Hausman was born in Belleville, Illinois, lives in St. Peters, Missouri, and graduated from Roxana High School.
She attended Eastern Illinois University, where she studied political science.

Her career experience includes working as a director of marketing and business development with Rockwood Lumber Co, a community relations representative at Keough Chiropractic, and a marketing director for Minuteman Press.

In the Missouri House, Hausman was assigned to the Children and Families Committee, the Professional Registration and Licensing Committee, the Emerging Issues Committee, the Legislative Review Committee and the Joint Committee on Government Accountability for 2025-2026.
In 2023-2024 she was vice chair of the Children and Families Committee.
